sources.title: Raghav-Singhal/pathlang-1p7b-runB-en-first · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 1.7B-parameter bilingual (English + Chinese) language model, part of a controlled language-ordering study. Three models share the same architecture, initialization, total data diet (50B English + 50B Chinese = 100B tokens), and LR schedule; they differ only in the order in which the two languages are presented during pretraining.
